snippet.title: The Last Caretaker | Update 5: New Horizons Trailer
snippet.description:
Update 5: New Horizons begins humanity’s next step in The Last Caretaker.
Watch the trailer, then play the update now in Early Access!

What’s new in Update 5: New Horizons
Project Eden begins: Build the first visible stage of Earth’s restoration as committee progress turns into something you can see growing in the world.
The Committees awaken: Humans launched into orbit now push humanity’s long-term future forward through new development paths and restoration goals.

Project Jonah: A new whale encounter, questline, lore, rewards, and a dedicated summoning location.

Cultural Memories: Discover Cave Paintings, HoloMemories, Statue Spires, Samples, and other traces of the world that came before.

New exploration and quest content: Enter Theta-9, a sealed research facility built to study Roth’s Anomaly, and follow new questlines.

New tools and systems: Use TideRipper™ Hand Jets, the Rhino Dismantler, Recovery Grinder, PECO Grid Scan 2000, Data Recovery Deck music playback, Rocket Payload fabrication, and more.

Major technical improvements: New wave and weather systems, reduced memory consumption, HDR support, controller and UI improvements, and optimization across gameplay systems, vehicles, physics, cables, weather, and large save games.

Enhanced localization: Italian and Spanish in-game text translations added 

Early Access means the mission keeps evolving.

Keep sending feedback, reports, screenshots, and strange discoveries from the ocean.

Continue the directive.
Save humanity.

Buy The Last Caretaker now on: 
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1783560/The_Last_Caretaker/
Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/p/the-last-caretaker-51dfcc

Join our Discord: discord.gg/channel37
